result.quote: Since he had much livestock in the foothills and in the plain, he built towers in the desert and dug many cisterns.
result.reason: Verse 26:10 directly gives his abundant livestock as the reason for both the desert towers and the cisterns. The following farming detail explains why he employed farmers and vinedressers, not why he built these structures. The edit preserves the original inquiry while correcting its causal answer.
